name: mtob_kalamang
origin: MTOB (Tanzer et al., ICLR 2024): learn Kalamang <-> English from one grammar book; <250K tokens English, <25K tokens Kalamang; word list; 375 paired sentences. Kalamang (<200 speakers) is held out of the web.
notes: A real 'language nobody knows'. Reported: Gemini 1.5 Pro (1M context) 59.1 chrF vs 57.0 for the first author; other LLM baselines ~45. Needs a long context: the natural test for a state that reads a book.
